Remark
Source: topping:page-0074 1. ch6:4.3\group topping-gradient-flow If $d\mathcal F/dt=0$ along (6.4.1)--(6.4.2), then $\Ric +\Hess (f)=0$. On a compact manifold the associated Ricci flow is Ricci flat, so it is a steady gradient soliton.
